desc: Prove enumeration is feasible: enumerate \(R=\min(K,N-K)\), since \(\binom{N}{R}=\binom{N}{K}\le 10^6\).
Select complement reduction: if enumerating excluded elements, selected XOR is `total_xor ^ excluded_xor`.
Design DFS/backtracking state `(start_index, remaining_to_choose, current_xor)` with only combinatorial bounds.
Verify Python integers safely support all XOR values below \(2^{60}\).
Produce stdin/stdout Python implementation using complement-aware DFS and validate it against both samples.
